verdict.rationale: Circle is a data-handling developer platform that ships AI tooling (MCP server, agent stack), so an AI-training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any training opt-out, data-usage policy, or retention control for AI models. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
